title: DUET: two-part hurdle testing for single-cell differential expression in Python
description: DUET (Detection-Expression Unified Test) implements cell-level two-part hurdle testing and a donor-level pseudobulk arm for single-cell RNA sequencing in Python, with underflow-safe log-scale significance. The repository contains the package, its tests and the analysis scripts behind the accompanying manuscript (agreement with R MAST, benchmarks, muscat simulations, calibration and donor-swap null experiments).
